item.text: Billing already reads the subscription, but most quotas, feature checks and workspace labels read the stored workspace plan. The burst limiter also defaults to Free because its plan context is never set. I’ll make workspace reads resolve the subscription plan and pass that plan to each workspace rate-limit check. The trial sweep also needs to filter for subscriptions still marked as trialing.
